bug_fixes: existing-install-update: Allow consensus update to update supported Python, pipx, uv and Git installations using their existing method, preserving optional capabilities and protecting local changes and installation ownership.
negative-control-false-positives: Disable the forum.centrala-termica.ro and RamblerDating checks after they reported accounts for synthetic negative usernames.
other_changes: shared-update-action: Offer Install update in Settings for Python and source copies, with confirmation before closing the session and verified completion or clear failure reporting.
consistent-update-guidance: Use the same consensus update instruction across installation methods and explain which recovery options require installer-managed snapshots.

bug_fixes: late-update-notice: Show background update results in the interface even when the check finishes after startup.
other_changes: universal-update-notices: Notify Python, pipx, uv and source installations about new releases without changing their installation method, with appropriate update instructions in Settings and explicit checks.
unmanaged-change-summary: Show a one-time bundled change summary when a Python or source installation first runs a new version.

bug_fixes: email-scan-limit: Apply custom and Quick limits to email lookup modules as well as username checks, retaining separate email domain analysis and existing safety restrictions.
3dcadforums-false-positive: Disable the 3DCADForums check after it returned account matches for both synthetic negative usernames.
other_changes: guided-search-size: Offer Quick, Custom and Full choices before guided username and email searches, with a session default in Settings and visible command shortcuts.
balanced-scan-limits: Aim for equal site and module shares in limited searches, filling unused slots from the other group without exceeding the chosen total.

bug_fixes: combined-scan-limit: Apply --top to the combined site and module checks per username, keeping enrichment eligible and existing safety restrictions in force.
custom-limit-label: Show the requested scan limit instead of an inherited Quick label, and keep site and module ranking identifiers separate.
false-positive-checks: Disable eleven site checks that returned positive signals for synthetic negative controls. Protonmail remains available.
other_changes: elapsed-seconds: Show elapsed seconds in the status bar, retain the final duration after completion or stopping, and reset it for the next search.
public-package-presentation: Make PyPI images and documentation links resolve correctly, and link package metadata and release notes directly to the OSINT Experts Society.

bug_fixes: investigation-input: Keep investigations open and explain invalid selections or missing saved searches.
analyst-decisions: Retain analyst decisions and notes in results after follow-up searches.
followup-back: Return to the current investigation when a follow-up is cancelled or no new sources are available.
input-space: Keep the input frame visible after long console output and prompts.
other_changes: search-new-sources: Search newly added lookup coverage for a saved identifier without repeating completed lookups.
search-comparison: Compare observations and retain earlier dated evidence when a result changes or cannot be rechecked.
evidence-explanations: Show assessment explanations and observation times across console, HTML and graph results.
quick-to-full: Start with up to 300 username lookups, then continue the full search with completed work retained.
local-investigations: Save named investigations with multiple searches, notes and analyst decisions.
windows-launch: Create a Start menu shortcut and offer to open Consensus after interactive installation.
product-examples: Add maintenance facts, an enriched-result example and downloadable fictional reports to the README.

bug_fixes: terminal-resize-reflow: Prevent repeated input borders when narrowing the Windows console after viewing results.
other_changes: beginner-installation: Add numbered Windows installation and first-search steps.
runtime-distribution: Refine packaged catalogue metadata.

bug_fixes: settings-back-navigation: Escape and 0 return one menu level, cancel unsubmitted settings and restore the home screen.
other_changes: paired-interactive-reports: Default Save report creates HTML and interactive graph reports with separate console links.

bug_fixes: history-invalid-snapshot: Reject damaged saved search metadata and preserve current results if opening fails.
history-fresh-filters: Opening a saved search clears filters from the previous result set.
rollback-manual-resume: A manual update resumes automatic updates even when the installed version is already current.
current-update-message: Only request a restart when an installed change is pending.
powershell-migration: Prevent inherited PowerShell 7 modules from breaking the Windows bootstrap during migration.
windows-restart: Keep the launcher attached while the restarted Windows console is running.

other_changes: private-managed-installer: Install with an included runtime bootstrap and private bundle channel.
source-migration: Switch source installations while preserving configuration and report locations.
updates-screen: View versions, check status, change counts and restart from Settings.
installation-recovery: Repair from the verified cached package or restore a previous validated version.
optional-search-history: Opt in to retaining and reopening up to ten local result sets.
results-actions: Save reports, filter rows and prefill another search directly from results.

bug_fixes: active-query-context: Display the search phase and identifier that were previously discarded by the interactive console.
other_changes: persistent-result-headings: Keep query context and named columns visible while scrolling, including bulk groups and horizontal navigation.
search-journey-guidance: Show relevant scan controls, explain empty and partial results, and open full analysis without repeated marketing.

bug_fixes: scrollbar-drag-capture: Keep thumb dragging responsive when the pointer leaves the narrow track.
results-home-restoration: Reset terminal geometry and redraw the full home after reviewing results.
other_changes: single-row-project-matrix: Keep one row per hit with compact named project columns and horizontal navigation when needed.
results-navigation-toolbar: Provide prominent menu/back buttons and a compact two-line controls bar.

bug_fixes: scan-task-resources: Bound scheduled checks and finish cleanup even after repeated cancellation.
scan-console-redraws: Limit progress redraws during bursts of completed checks.
fast-scroll-footer: Avoid formatting the status footer for every wheel event.
results-return-navigation: Keep a visible Back control and prevent repeated Escape from dismissing results.
report-save-home: Restore the full home screen and a concise saved-file link after export.
report-branding-current: Use the current Consensus wordmark and Society endorsement in HTML, graph and PDF reports.
other_changes: clear-result-evidence: Name coverage projects, explain possible matches, and separate enrichment fields from values.
escape-stops-scan: Support Escape alongside S to stop a scan and retain collected results.
scan-osint-tips: Rotate local OSINT tips during searches and label source credits Projects combined.

bug_fixes: results-scroll-resources: Render visible result rows without rebuilding and caching the entire document on every scroll.
results-scrollbar: Keep a visible scrollbar with arrows, paging and thumb dragging in the results viewport.
console-link-boundaries: Keep links scoped to explicit labels across results scrolling and redraws.
console-completion-scroll: Follow completed results to the bottom and support bounded keyboard and wheel navigation.
other_changes: console-results-matrix: Show compact project coverage and open enrichment evidence on demand.
calmer-actions: Space the action columns, group Examples with search and add a framed input field with placeholder guidance.
action-panels: Separate search and results panels with option descriptions and result availability hints.
update-summary: Show reviewed module, bug-fix and other-change counts after updates and on restart.
community-box: Group the community links in a labelled Join the Community box.
